```{r}
#| label: setup
library(ggplot2)
library(phwstyle)
use_phw_ggplot()
use_phw_flextable()
# Optional: keep group colours the same in every report.
# phw_key_file("phw-colours.csv")
set.seed(44)
d <- expand.grid(period = 1:13, group = paste("Group", 1:4))
d$value <- round(runif(nrow(d), 20, 120) + d$period * 4, 1)
```

## Summary

> A key message goes here, in a highlighted box.

- First point.
- Second point.

## Section heading

```{r}
#| label: fig-line
#| fig-cap: "Figure caption describing the chart"
ggplot(d, aes(period, value, colour = group, shape = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  scale_colour_phw_d(key = "group") +
  scale_shape_phw() +
  labs(x = "Period", y = "Value", caption = phw_caption("Example data", date = Sys.Date()))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-facet
#| fig-cap: "Small multiples, one panel per group"
#| fig-height: 5
ggplot(d, aes(period, value)) +
  geom_area(fill = phw_col("light_teal"), alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(colour = phw_col("navy"), linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~group) +
  labs(x = "Period", y = "Value", caption = phw_caption("Example data"))
```

## Table

```{r}
#| label: tbl-example
#| tbl-cap: "Table caption"
tbl <- data.frame(Category = paste("Category", LETTERS[1:5]),
                  Count = c(114L, 84L, 64L, 19L, 23L),
                  `Share (%)` = c(11.7, 8.6, 6.6, 1.9, 2.4), check.names = FALSE)
if (knitr::is_html_output() || knitr::pandoc_to("docx")) {
  phw_flextable(tbl, source = "Example data")
} else {
  knitr::kable(tbl)
}
```
